answer: Persistent work-history pulse: each identity accumulates a slow-decaying activity score from prior accepted transactions. New identities start near zero and only gain score through real settled work, verified by countersigned receipts. A raven flag marks identities whose receipt graph stays too sparse after a grace window, throttling their matchmaking. Operators cloning identities pay the full ramp-up cost per clone: fresh score, fresh receipts, fresh grace period. A mirror check compares an identity's claimed history against receipt timestamps,
